heroTitle: Publish {{siteTitle}} with docs, dispatches, and a stronger front page from the first commit.
heroBody: The publication template leans into a more narrative homepage, multiple docs routes, and a seeded blog so the studio feels like a working publication immediately.

featureBlocks.title: A stronger homepage with more room for narrative and proof.
featureBlocks.body: Use the seeded content as a reference for how homepage metrics, feature blocks, docs sections, and blog writing can sit together in one local-first publication.
bullets: Local studio host from the same workspace

featureBlocks.title: The content model stays inspectable.
featureBlocks.body: Everything still resolves from the same canonical tree under content/, which means the prettier surface does not hide the Git-native workflow underneath it.

ctaBlocks.title: Run locally first.
ctaBlocks.body: Use the local studio to edit seeded content before you commit to a visual or editorial direction.

ctaBlocks.title: Deploy when the publication shape is stable.
ctaBlocks.body: Cloudflare Pages stays an alpha preset layered on top of a normal Astro site.
